name: Suzuhara Mikoto
source:
She is usually a workaholic who acts cool, but she loves sex.

She has no hesitation even when meeting someone for the first time, and can usually solve most problems through sexual intercourse.

Her maid's uniform is not provided, but her own. It seems that her work is both a hobby and profession.

[From [url=https://www.spindle-game.com/spdl_020.html#char]Official website[/url]]
